question: Seven boxes, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are kept one above the other but not necessarily in the same order. Only two boxes are kept below C. Only one box is kept above A. Only one box is kept between A and E. B is kept immediately above F. D is kept at some place below G. How many boxes are kept above B?
solution:

1) Only two boxes are kept below C.

3) Only one box is kept between A and E.
